So the Prayer from Matt 6 and every other case should be Abanaw" / "i want the yod removed from the tokens for the word, not just the transliteraton. The letters need to be 𐤀𐤁𐤍𐤅 (father [our])". A rule REMOVES one component from a word's tokens: root = the root component's letters; sn = its Strong's; drop = the css of the component removed; before = the css of the suffix it must stand in front of; retired / form = the spelling no reading text may carry any more and the one it becomes (prefixes Wa/Ha/Ba/La/Ma/Ka/Sha stay in front). Read by modform-lib.mjs (reading text + parallel gate), build-surface-index.js (baked chips, rendered_paleo) and server.js (live parser, older index). The corpus word_raw is not rewritten.
